root_idea.summary: The root denotes a covering, sheath, or enveloping layer placed around something.
root_idea.development: Its semantic development runs from a physical covering or receptacle to the state of being enclosed, and metaphorically to a heart closed off from receiving or understanding.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested plural form غُلْف is presented under the supported singular dictionary citation form غِلَاف.

senses.definition: Covered or enclosed as though surrounded by a sheath; figuratively, closed off from hearing and accepting the truth.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌ, the hearts are portrayed as enclosed and therefore unreceptive. The attested Quranic form is the plural غُلْف.

senses.definition: Receptacles or repositories of knowledge, implying that the hearts already contain knowledge and need no further instruction.
senses.usage_conditions: An explicitly reported alternative reading and interpretation of the same Quranic expression; it should not be confused with the ordinary covered or enclosed interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a bottle, flask, knife, sword, bow, saddle, or similar object into a sheath or other covering; to furnish it with a covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive covering or encasing action; the Form II usage is explicitly cross-referenced with this covering sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To smear or daub the beard, or oneself, with perfume, especially ghāliyah, or with henna.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for external application to the beard or body; a reported usage distinguishes this from related forms for application at the roots of the hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be uncircumcised; the state of being uncircumcised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The first form is verbal and the second is its verbal noun or state noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have or acquire a sheath or covering, especially a leather or similar covering on a saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive construction describing an object as covered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of tree used in tanning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is sometimes said to be used together with the tree called غَرْف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant and unstraitened, especially of herbage, a year, land, or the means and comforts of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to land rich in unpastured herbage, a plentiful year, or an ample and easy life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain edible plant associated particularly with apes or monkeys.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name, not a general adjective of covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prepuce: the piece of skin removed in circumcision from the sheath of the glans.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, also equated with قُلْفَةٌ and غُرْلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two end portions of the moustache next to the corners of the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual anatomical expression referring to the two sides nearest the points where the lips meet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A receptacle, sheath, case, covering, or envelope; including a sword or knife sheath, a bottle case, a bow or saddle covering, the enclosing membrane of the heart, the pellicle of an egg, a flower calyx, or the imagined sheath of the moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete noun covers containers and enclosing layers of various objects and body structures; its figurative application to hearts in the Quran is treated under the Quranic senses above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Enclosed in a sheath or other covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a sword, bow, or any other thing that is enclosed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man wearing a garment whose sleeves or body conceal his forearms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a person enclosed in a particular garment.
An adjective applied to a person; its feminine and plural forms are separately reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Provided with a leather or similar covering, especially said of a horse's or camel's saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial adjective describing an object furnished with a غِلَاف.

cautions: The QAC form غُلْف is a plural Quranic form and is normalized here under the supported singular citation form غِلَاف.
The receptacle-of-knowledge sense reflects an explicitly reported alternative reading or interpretation of the Quranic expression; QAC canonically identifies the supplied form group as غُلْف.
